45 minutos para darme dos hamburguesas frías y 2 gaseosas tibias. Estábamos esperandolas ahí mismo, adentro. Pidieron nombre de referencia (hasta incluso lo anotaron) Pero no fueron capaz de llamar. Según ví al acercarnos a la caja, las tenían listas pero no nos avisaron. Malísima la atención de Nazareno

(Translated by Google)
It took 45 minutes to get two cold hamburgers and two lukewarm sodas. We were waiting for them right there inside. They asked for a reference name (they even wrote it down), but they didn't bother to call. From what I saw when we got to the register, they had them ready, but they didn't let us know. Nazareno's service was terrible.
